retrievalProfile.description: A structured archival layout featuring a central duotone portrait framed by a black institutional header and a dynamic, angled geometric name banner.
triggerTerms: black top border with serif metadata

recipe.visualDefinition: A formal yet dynamic composition utilizing a three-tier horizontal structure: a thin black top bar for series identification, a secondary magenta accent strip, and a large mint-green field containing a centered duotone portrait overlaid with a thick, upward-slanted navy banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal institutional header vs. diagonal subject banner
Mint green background vs. purple/magenta accents
High-contrast black-and-white portrait vs. flat color fields
Formal serif metadata vs. bold sans-serif display type
coreInvariants: Black header bar at the absolute top edge
Upward diagonal slant of the primary name banner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-length portrait, scaled to fill the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, dark purple diagonal banner containing the primary subject name.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left institutional text, down to the angled banner, settling on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample mint-green space surrounding the head to allow for the diagonal banner overlay.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta (secondary strip) and Navy/Deep Purple (diagonal banner)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation background contrasted with high-value white text and deep, saturated geometric shapes.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of transitional serifs and geometric sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Header text uses small caps with high tracking
Main display text uses bold, heavy-weight geometric sans-serif
Secondary series text uses italicized serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a traditional, tracked-out serif for institutional authority and a bold, angled sans-serif for modern energy.
graphicDevices: Angled rectangular banner with sharp corners

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and clarity of the main display name.
Provides the necessary institutional serif look for the top header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mint-green square canvas. Place a centered, black-and-white duotone portrait of a man in a tuxedo in the lower two-thirds. Add a solid black bar at the top edge and a thin magenta strip immediately below it. Overlay a thick navy-blue rectangle slanted upwards at an 8-degree angle across the upper third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the institutional title in white small-caps serif with wide tracking inside the black top bar. Typeset the subject name in white bold geometric sans-serif, centered and rotated to match the angle of the navy-blue banner.

verificationChecks: Is the top header text in small caps with wide spacing?
Is the primary name banner angled upwards?
Is the portrait treated with a desaturated or duotone effect?
Are the color blocks flat without gradients?

adjustableVariables: Background color (mint green to light blue)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp geometric edges on banners
High legibility of white text against dark backgrounds
Balanced duotone contrast in the portrait
avoid: Neon or overly bright modern palettes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black bar is perfectly horizontal at the top.
Verify the magenta strip is thin and consistent.
Check that the diagonal banner does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Confirm the serif text in the header is uppercase/small-caps.
recipe.reuseFormula: Institutional Header + Accent Strip + Duotone Portrait + Angled Geometric Name Banner
